links.comparator_used: Same LLM configurations without retrieval augmentation (no retrieval from the curated pathology knowledge base)
links.outcome: Pairwise arena preference (Bradley-Terry ranking) of patient-facing pathology explanations
links.effect: Retrieval augmentation was associated with improved response preference; the top configuration (larger model plus curated pathology knowledge base retrieval) was strongly preferred over pathologist-written responses. No numeric estimates in the abstract.
links.quote: Pairwise arena comparisons indicated that the configuration parameters strongly influenced performance, with both model size and retrieval augmentation associated with improved response preference.

design_hint: retrieval-augmented generation grounding and prompting configuration
